title: FM27 Access Installer
notFound: Select a game installation or browse to its folder.
noReleases: No official installable releases have been published yet.
offline: Unable to check GitHub. Cached information is shown; a newer version may exist.
ready: Ready. Select an installation and mod version.
confirmRemove: Remove the managed FM27 Access files? Saves, settings, bookmarks, other mods and the shared BepInEx loader will be kept. Unchanged logging settings will be restored from their separate receipt.
confirmDowngrade: Install an older mod version? Newer settings may be incompatible. Back up your settings before continuing. Your saves will not be changed.
confirmUpdate: Download and restart with the newer installer? This updates only the installer program, independently of the mod.
noInstallerUpdate: The installer is up to date.
pending: Operation completed and files verified. Start Football Manager normally. The first launch may take several minutes while the game prepares the mod. There can be no speech during this stage. Leave the game open and wait for the Companion window.
cancelled: Operation cancelled. Any applied changes were rolled back.
cancelling: Cancelling safely. Please wait for recovery to finish.
failed: The operation could not be completed. Review technical details. If recovery is available, run it before retrying.
gameRunning: Close Football Manager and its Companion before changing the installation.
permission: The folder is not writable. Choose a writable game installation or review folder permissions.
network: Unable to contact GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
unmanaged: This installation was installed by another method. Use its original uninstaller or receipt before managing it here.
